record.title: Compose offline Linux reboot lease and health boundaries
record.intent: Replace the identified transition supervisor gap without contacting the instrument.
requirements: Pin the accepted Linux native boundary and independently reviewed integration design, original RebootLeaseGate and captured packet models, current namespace/tool/clock evidence and exact transaction source. Preserve all original peer, 86400-second lease, no gateway/DNS and forwarding-zero guarantees.

Implement a typed offline live-pcap event adapter and explicit one-shot transition health phases for one 180-second normal reboot. Only its bounded pre-new-ACK phase may permit carrier loss or invalidated lease; all ownership, isolation, capture and authorization guards remain active. A sent ACK is never captured authority. Require fresh matching REQUEST/ACK after intent, RELEASE only before new ACK inside the original window and DECLINE always stop.

Supply focused host-only controls with preserved captured or clearly synthetic fixtures for frame identity/options/order, RELEASE-after-ACK, DECLINE, phase expiry, changed clock domain and process identity. No DHCP service, namespace/network mutation, capture, ADB, SCPI, serial, native mutation or specimen contact occurs in this task.

Independently review and freeze the reusable boundary with exact source hashes, raw fixture provenance, limits and future runtime integration checklist. Do not fabricate future leases or grant physical B/A2 readiness from supplied controls.
acceptance: The reviewed offline lease/health composition or its precise remaining integration blocker is preserved.
